<!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang="ja">
        <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8">
            <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
            <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
            <script>
                window.onload = () => {
                    // (PC) ポップアップ経由で OAuth 連携を行った場合
                    if (window.opener) {
                        window.opener.postMessage({
                            'KonomiTV-OAuthPopup': {
                                'status': 401,
                                'detail': 'Authorization was denied (access_denied)',
                            }
                        }, '*');
                    // (スマホ・タブレット) リダイレクト経由で OAuth 連携を行った場合
                    } else {
                        location.href = `https://client.example.com/settings/jikkyo#status=401&detail=${encodeURIComponent('Authorization was denied (access_denied)')}`;
                    }
                };
            </script>
        </head>
        <body style="background: #1E1310; color: #FFEAEA;">
        </body>
        </html>
